## Summary

**MOV3Q** (Move 3-Bit Data Quick).

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `3-bit Immediate Data → <ea>` (LineA instruction) |
| Syntax | `MOV3Q #<data>,<ea>` |
| Description | Move immediate -1..7 to destination. Size is long. |
| Condition codes | see table |

### Condition codes

| X | N | Z | V | C |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| – | * | 0 | 0 | 0 |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–12 | `1010` |
| 1 | 11–9 | data |
| 1 | 8–6 | `001` |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |

- Data=0 represents -1

### Example

```asm
    mov3q.l    #7,d0
```

```text
Result:
d0: .. .. .. .. 00 00 00 07
```

### Notes

- This is a LineA instruction, set apollo-bit in SR to become active. (ori #$800,sr)
- Do not use, only available on cores 10280 to 10904

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no MOV3Q. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T use MOV3Q: the manual says it is only available on cores 10280 to 10904.
- DO set the Apollo bit (SR bit 11, `ori #$800,sr`) before any LineA instruction.
